subject.label: What to draw?
subject.response: Start by describing WHAT you want to see: a character, an animal, a place... For example: 'A dragon', 'A princess', 'A magical forest' 🎨

style.label: What style?
style.response: The style is how it will look! You can choose: cartoon, realistic photo, watercolor, pixel art, or magical/fairy ✨

mood.label: What mood?
mood.response: The mood gives the emotion! Is it: daytime/nighttime, happy/mysterious, bright/dark? 🌈

details.label: Details?
details.response: Details make everything unique! Think about colors (golden, blue), size (giant, tiny), special elements (shiny, rainbow) 💎

subject.label: What to animate?
subject.response: Describe what will move! A character dancing, an object flying, a landscape changing... 🎬

style.label: What style?
style.response: For a video, the style can be: realistic, cartoon, magical, or even abstract! ✨

movement.label: How does it move?
movement.response: Describe the movement: does it run, fly, spin? Is it slow and gentle or fast and dynamic? 🏃‍♀️

mood.label: What mood?
mood.response: Your video's mood: happy, mysterious, epic, calm... It changes everything! 🌟

steps.chooseImage:
To create your video, you first need to choose an image.

Look in your gallery and choose the one you want to animate.
steps.describeVideo:
Good image.

Now, what happens? Describe the action.

Example: "The dragon opens its wings" or "The stars spin slowly"
steps.describeBeginner:
Tell me what you imagine.

Example: "A dragon flying over a castle" or "A fairy in a forest"
steps.describeAdvanced: What do you want to create? Describe your idea to me.
steps.chooseStyle:
Good.

Now, drawing, photo, or magical?

Choose a style.
steps.chooseMood:
What emotion? What light?

The mood is the emotion you feel when looking at it.
steps.chooseLight:
What light for your {type}?

Sun, moon, candle... Light changes everything.
steps.chooseFormat:
What shape?

• Portrait — vertical, for a character
• Landscape — horizontal, for a scene
• Square — versatile
steps.chooseMovement:
How will your video move?

• Slow and gentle
• Fast and dynamic
• Almost still

Movement brings the image to life.
steps.chooseCamera:
How does the camera move?

• Zoom in — getting closer
• Zoom out — getting farther
• Tracking — following the movement
• Fixed
steps.chooseExtraImage: If you want, you can add details: colors, textures... It's optional.
steps.chooseExtraVideo: If you want, you can specify the movement type. It's optional.
steps.reviewLevel4:
Here's your prompt.

You wrote it. You know how to talk to AI.
steps.reviewLevel2:
Here's the prompt.

This is exactly what we send to the AI to create your {type}. See how it's structured? Style, description, mood — that's how you talk to AI.
steps.reviewDefault:

This is what we'll send to create your {type}. You can modify it if you want.
steps.safariLevel5: You know the way. Fal.ai is waiting for you.
steps.safariLevel4: You're ready. Click to go to fal.ai — you know how.

Fal.ai is the tool real creators use. And what you learned with me works exactly the same there.

Import your creation to keep it.

step1.title: Open fal.ai
step1.description: Click the link to open the fal.ai page. This is where you'll create your images!
step1.tip: 💡 fal.ai is a magical site that turns your ideas into images.

step2.title: Find the text box
step2.description: You'll see a large rectangle where you can type. That's where you paste your prompt!
step2.tip: 💡 The prompt is the magical description of your image.

step3.title: Paste your prompt
step3.description: Press Cmd+V (or Ctrl+V on PC) to paste the magical text your AI friend helped you create.
step3.tip: 💡 The text comes from the "Copy" button you clicked before!

step4.title: Click Run!
step4.description: Find the "Run" button (usually blue or purple) and click it. The magic begins!
step4.tip: 💡 It may take a few seconds, be patient!

step5.title: Download your image!
step5.description: Your image appears! Right-click on it, then "Save image as..." to download it.
step5.tip: 💡 Then drag your image into La Voix du Soir to add it to your gallery!

step1.title: Open fal.ai
step1.description: Click the link to open the fal.ai Videos page. Let's create magical videos!
step1.tip: 💡 Kling is the engine that brings your ideas to life as video.

step2.title: Find the text box
step2.description: Look for the large rectangle to type in. This is where you describe your video!
step2.tip: 💡 For a video, describe what MOVES: "a cat jumping", "stars twinkling"...

step3.title: Paste your prompt
step3.description: Press Cmd+V (or Ctrl+V on PC) to paste your magical text.
step3.tip: 💡 Your prompt describes the movement and mood of your video.

step4.title: Click Run!
step4.description: Find the "Run" button and click it. Creating a video takes a bit longer!
step4.tip: 💡 A video may take 1-2 minutes to create. That's normal!

step5.title: Download your video!
step5.description: Your video is ready! Click the download button (usually a downward arrow).
step5.tip: 💡 Drag your video into La Voix du Soir to add it to your collection!

step1.title: Welcome to fal.ai! 🎨
step1.description: fal.ai is a magical site that turns your words into images. It's super simple to use!
step1.tip: It's like a magical painter who draws what you describe!

step2.title: Open fal.ai 🚀
step2.description: Click the button to open fal.ai in Safari. The page will open by itself!
step2.tip: fal.ai is just a simple website.

step3.title: Find the text box 📝
step3.description: You'll see a large white rectangle where you can type. That's where you'll paste your prompt!
step3.tip: The prompt is the magical description of your image.

step4.title: Paste your prompt ✨
step4.description: Press Cmd + V at the same time to paste your magical text.
step4.tip: The text comes from the 'Copy' button you clicked before!

step5.title: Click Run! 🎯
step5.description: Find the 'Run' button (usually blue or purple) and click it. Let's go!

step6.title: Wait for the magic ⏳
step6.description: fal.ai is creating your image... It only takes a few seconds! You'll see the image appear.

step7.title: Download your image 💾
step7.description: Right-click on your image, then choose 'Save image'.
step7.tip: Put it somewhere easy to find!

step8.title: Well done! 🎉
step8.description: You created your first image with fal.ai! Now drag it into the app to add it to your gallery.
step8.tip: You can create as many images as you want!

step1.title: Welcome to fal.ai! 🎬
step1.description: fal.ai can also create magical videos from your descriptions!
step1.tip: It's like a film director who brings your imagination to life!

step2.title: Open fal.ai 🚀
step2.description: Click the button to open fal.ai Videos in Safari.
step2.tip: It's the same site, but a special page for videos.

step3.title: Find the text box 📝
step3.description: You'll see a large rectangle to type in. This is where you describe your video!
step3.tip: For videos, think about describing what MOVES.

step4.title: Paste your prompt ✨
step4.description: Press Cmd + V to paste the magical text that describes your video.
step4.tip: Your prompt describes movement: 'a cat jumping', 'stars twinkling'...

step5.title: Click Run! 🎯
step5.description: Find the 'Run' button and click it to start creating your video!
step5.tip: Videos take a bit longer than images.

step6.title: Wait for the magic ⏳
step6.description: fal.ai is creating your video... It takes about 1-2 minutes. Be patient, it's worth it!
step6.tip: It's normal for it to take longer, there are lots of images to create!

step7.title: Watch the result 👀
step7.description: When it's ready, your video will play by itself. See if you like it!
step7.tip: If you don't like it, you can try again with a different prompt.

step8.title: Download your video 💾
step8.description: Click the download button (a downward arrow) to save your video.
step8.tip: Choose carefully where to put it so you can find it easily!

step9.title: Well done! 🎉
step9.description: You created your first video with fal.ai! Drag it into the app to add it to your collection.
step9.tip: You can now animate all your stories!

modeIntro.stepsToFollow: Here are the steps you'll follow

writing.title: The Writing Workshop
writing.subtitle: Become a magical storyteller
writing.description: Here, you'll learn to tell incredible stories with the help of your magical assistant. She'll teach you the 5 Magic Questions to create stories that captivate everyone!
writing.objective0: Learn to ask the right questions to build a story
writing.objective1: Develop your imagination with unique characters and worlds
writing.objective2: Master the art of talking to artificial intelligences
writing.level0Desc: You discover the basics with your magical friend who guides you
writing.level1Desc: You start using the 5 Magic Questions
writing.level2Desc: You create richer and richer stories
writing.level3Desc: You master the art of storytelling
writing.level4Desc: You can create stories with any AI!
writing.reward: You'll be able to create extraordinary stories and talk to all the AIs in the world with your new skills!

saveError.title: Cannot save
saveError.description: Your changes haven't been saved for 2 minutes. Your session probably expired. Reload the page to reconnect and restore automatic saving.

studio.title: The Creative Studio
studio.subtitle: Turn your ideas into images
studio.description: In this magical studio, you'll learn to create incredible images and videos just with words! The 5 Magic Keys will help you become a real digital artist.
studio.objective0: Learn to precisely describe what you imagine
studio.objective1: Discover the secrets of style, mood, and lighting
studio.objective2: Create images worthy of a professional artist
studio.level0Desc: You discover how the AI understands your words
studio.level1Desc: You learn the 5 Keys: Style, Hero, Mood...
studio.level2Desc: You use real AI tools like fal.ai
studio.level3Desc: You create complex and detailed works
studio.level4Desc: You can create any image imaginable!
studio.reward: You'll know how to create beautiful images and videos with any AI tool, like a real professional!

montage.title: The Editing Table
montage.subtitle: Become a movie director
montage.description: Here, you'll assemble your creations to make real movies! Add music, sound effects, voices, and animations to bring your stories to life.
montage.objective0: Learn to organize scenes like a director
montage.objective2: Create emotions with rhythm and effects
montage.level0Desc: You discover how to create your first scene
montage.reward: You'll be able to create entire movies with music, voices, and special effects, like a real director!

theater.title: The Theater
theater.subtitle: Present your creations to the world
theater.description: The curtain rises! This is where you can watch your movies on the big screen and show them to your family and friends. Get comfortable, the show is about to begin!
theater.objective0: Discover your creations like at the cinema
theater.objective1: Share your stories with the people you love
theater.objective2: See the final result of all your work
theater.level1Desc: You show your movies to your family
theater.reward: You'll experience the magic of seeing your stories come to life on the big screen!

publish.title: The Magic Printing Press
publish.subtitle: Turn your stories into real books
publish.description: Amazing! Here, you can turn your digital story into a real book that you can hold in your hands, give as a gift, or keep preciously in your library.
publish.objective0: Choose the perfect format for your book
publish.objective1: Check that everything is ready for printing
publish.level0Desc: You prepare your book for printing
publish.level1Desc: You receive your first printed book
publish.level2Desc: You have several books to your name!
publish.reward: You'll have a real book with your name on it, like a real author!

challenge.title: The Challenge Arena
challenge.subtitle: Train yourself to talk to AIs
challenge.description: Welcome to the arena! Here, you'll train to write prompts like a pro. Reproduce images, create variations, and become an expert in communicating with AIs!
challenge.objective0: Learn to observe and precisely describe an image
challenge.objective1: Understand which words the AI understands best
challenge.objective2: Master the art of modifying a prompt to change the result
challenge.reward: You'll know how to perfectly talk to AIs and create exactly what you imagine!
